additional_info.subject: ID0477624-DC/Si-D/FR- [Y2 / R8 313202799066] Router isn't connected to SCB CRM:03276000088
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0477624
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-XX SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2 / R8 313202799066
Charger ID / Serial No.:
5Mtt7r
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason: Router isn't connected to SCB
Please follow the steps below during your site visit to resolve the connectivity issues with the charger.
On-site Inspection Steps:
1. Check if the router is pingable (IP: 10.20.17.1).
2. Verify whether you can connect to the WebUI. The password is available in SCB.
3. Check the mobile network data status.
4. Verify that the SIM card is properly inserted.
5. Replacing the router should be considered only as a last-case scenario after all checks above are completed and you can use the CompanionTool to install it.
6. For routers RUT241, the password is behind the router on a sticker
Spare Part Information:
•
8EM5903-0AA05-7AA5
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-XX SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Felipe Moraes
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
